completenessChecks: All five paragraphs translated in order; the single hyperlink (Or Knispel item) kept on the same words.
No images in the source; footer says so.
voiceChecks: Plain trade-news register kept; quotations from Nirit Weiss and Yehoram Dilmani translated as printed.
decisions: 'סגניה' rendered 'deputies to Nirit Weiss' (the Hebrew makes both appointees her deputies).
'מבניה המובחרים של וואלה!' rendered 'one of Walla!'s finest sons' to keep the idiom.

sourceProblems: The source omits the opening quotation mark before Nirit Weiss's statement but closes it; the English reproduces the same asymmetry rather than correcting it.
